project_type: Full-stack app: FastAPI backend (apps/api/) + Next.js 15 frontend (apps/web/)
build_system: uv (Python), pnpm (Node.js), Makefile at root for convenience commands
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient with ASGI transport for API tests, mocked DB via dependency_overrides
build_command: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && cd ../../apps/web && pnpm build
test_command: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check on backend. 2. Run pytest tests/ -v. 3. Run pnpm build in apps/web/.
setup_instructions: cd apps/api && uv sync; cd apps/web && pnpm install
environment_constraints: Docker NOT available - cannot run Qdrant, postgres, redis. All tests must mock external services. No torch/sentence-transformers (too heavy) - use fastembed. No Celery/Redis - ingestion runs synchronously. OPEN_INTERNET network mode allows installing packages.
contribution_requirements: Push to main branch. Clean commits. Tests must pass without external services.

key_patterns.models: SQLAlchemy ORM models in apps/api/app/model/, each file exports one model class using DeclarativeBase. Models registered in __init__.py.
key_patterns.schemas: Pydantic models in apps/api/app/schema/ for request/response validation.
key_patterns.routers: FastAPI routers in apps/api/app/router/, registered in main.py with prefix /api/v1. Each router file has `router = APIRouter(prefix=..., tags=[...])`.
key_patterns.deps: Dependency injection via apps/api/app/deps.py - get_db yields AsyncSession, get_current_user decodes JWT.
key_patterns.tests: Tests in apps/api/tests/ using conftest.py fixtures: mock_user, mock_db (AsyncMock), client (httpx AsyncClient with dependency overrides).
key_patterns.alembic: Migrations in apps/api/alembic/versions/ with sequential numeric revision IDs (001, 002, ...).
key_patterns.settings: Pydantic BaseSettings in apps/api/app/settings.py with env vars. Already has QDRANT_URL.
key_patterns.frontend: Next.js 15 App Router. (app) group for authenticated pages, (auth) for login/signup. Components in src/components/, hooks in src/hooks/, API client in src/lib/api.ts.
key_patterns.sse_streaming: Chat uses SSE with event types: token, chart, table, code, done, error. Frontend useChat hook processes these events.

directory_structure: apps/api/ - FastAPI backend (app/, alembic/, tests/); apps/web/ - Next.js frontend (src/app/, src/components/, src/hooks/, src/lib/); docs/ - documentation; infra/ - infrastructure configs; packages/ - shared packages
